[短篇][story/anthology] 弦自己找到频率之后的第五十三年，未竟厅设了「听弦」一职。最年轻的书记员阿汐被派上北崖，日复一日，把听见写进册子里——哪怕听不见。第三十一年，风停了一整天，弦终于问了世界一句：谁在听。

transitions.fromZh: 阿汐将纸袋留在门边，袋口压着「听留下」
transitions.fromEn: Axi leaves the paper bag by the door, its mouth resting over “Listening remains.”
transitions.toZh: 阿汐读出袋上的字，纸袋仍留在原处
transitions.toEn: Axi reads the words on the bag aloud; the bag remains where it is.
transitions.narrativeZh: 她不再把纸袋当作来信，而把「听留下」读给屋子听。
transitions.narrativeEn: She stops treating the bag as a letter and reads “Listening remains” to the room.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 门缝送来带盐味的凉风，袋上的字没有改变。
transitions.npcReactionEn: A cool, salt-scented draft passes through the door; the words on the bag do not change.
transitions.atlasHookEn: Three words read beside the paper bag

transitions.fromZh: 窗台盐线断成两截，中间空处仍未填上
transitions.fromEn: The sill’s salt line lies in two halves, with the space between them still unfilled.
transitions.toZh: 阿汐不再数盐线，只在退潮时看海
transitions.toEn: Axi stops counting the salt line and watches the sea at ebb.
transitions.narrativeZh: 她不再用刻度追问空处，把退潮留给海自己记数。
transitions.narrativeEn: She stops measuring the empty space and leaves the ebb to keep its own count.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 阿沉留下的刻度仍在，木板没有记下铜扣。
transitions.npcReactionEn: A-Chen’s marks remain; the floorboard records no count of the button.

transitions.fromZh: 渡人称铜扣已是念头，并在薄页上留下空格
transitions.fromEn: The ferryman calls the button an intention and leaves a blank on the thin page.
transitions.toZh: 阿汐让空格保持空白，铜扣与铁钉仍置于木板旁
transitions.toEn: Axi leaves the blank empty; the button and iron nail remain beside the floorboard.
transitions.narrativeZh: 她不替空格命名，也不把铜扣放进窗台的空处。
transitions.narrativeEn: She gives the blank no name and does not place the button in the sill’s empty space.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 木板没有记下空格，铜扣也没有被称出重量。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The floorboard records no blank, and the button weighs nothing on the scale.

transitions.fromZh: 阿沉把《回声谷》的旧纸贴在门边，末行留白
transitions.fromEn: A-Chen pins the old Echo Vale sheet beside the door, its final line blank.
transitions.toZh: 阿沉在旧纸上写下「听」，不再添第二个字
transitions.toEn: A-Chen writes “listen” on the old sheet and adds no second character.
transitions.narrativeZh: 旧纸多出一个字；那行没有因此变成完整的回答。
transitions.narrativeEn: One character appears on the old sheet; the line does not thereby become a complete answer.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 风来时，「听」字自行轻颤，屋里无人续写。
transitions.npcReactionEn: When the wind comes, “listen” trembles on its own; no one writes on.
transitions.atlasHookZh: 回声谷旧纸上的一个字
transitions.atlasHookEn: One character on the Echo Vale sheet

atlasDraft.pZh: 铜扣和铁钉并排放着。阿汐没有数它们。窗台的空处仍在，薄页上的空格也仍在。她把手收回袖中，听海经过门外，没有替它记下声音。
atlasDraft.pEn: The button and the nail lay side by side. Axi did not count them. The empty space on the sill remained, as did the blank in the thin ledger. She drew her hand into her sleeve and listened as the sea passed outside the door, leaving its sound unrecorded.
atlasDraft.codaEn: Some empty spaces do not wait for an answer.
